summary: ExchangeRight Income Fund (the Company) filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, reporting its quarterly net asset value (NAV) as of March 31, 2026. The Trustee declared NAV of $801,761,000 ($27.58 per common share/OP Unit across Class I, A, S, D). This is a routine periodic disclosure of NAV per share/unit, as required by the Company's valuation guidelines, with no strategic event, transaction, or corporate action involved. The filing updates shareholders on the fund's quarterly performance.
